review_method: Read-only inspection of commit e8f0dd6, the round-2 verdict, and the affected current files. Per the subagent constraint, no build, browser run, test, lint, or other verification command was run; coordinator-reported runtime totals are identified as supplied evidence rather than independently reproduced.

per_item_verdicts.title: D21 query-free/repeated-asset same-origin egress residual
evidence: scripts/browser-check.mjs:3622-3639 creates and attaches the fresh target, enables Network, registers the session-scoped requestWillBeSent collector, and only then navigates to the scenario URL, so boot traffic is captured before the app loads.

scripts/browser-check.mjs:3666-3684 removes the old asset-shape allowlist semantics. d21QueryStringEgress only labels query-bearing offenders for diagnostics and is not consulted as a permission rule.

scripts/browser-check.mjs:4176-4239 waits after __SXC1_BOOTED until the request stream has been quiet for 700 ms (8 s cap), snapshots bootCount, runs enable/grant/emit/confirmation, and passes D21 only when the post-snapshot request slice is empty and bootCount is nonzero.

scripts/browser-check.mjs:1135-1164 implements the three distinct exfiltration sabotages: query-string same-origin fetch, query-free asset-shaped path carrying the received bytes, and an extra app.wasm fetch. scripts/browser-check.mjs:3602-3612 maps each selector to D21 alone.

The source maps 17 M4 selector passes; together with clean, legacy-all, and the 15 M3 selectors this yields the stated 34-pass sweep. The coordinator reports all 34/34 caught exactly their mapped assertions. That run was not repeated here.
per_item_verdicts.assessment: The round-2 false-green classes are closed. No same-origin URL, path shape, or repeated real asset is permitted after the settled boot snapshot; all become nonzero scenario deltas. The bootCount >= 1 floor proves the collector observed the target's boot request stream.

per_item_verdicts.title: V6 floor gap for D23-D25
evidence: scripts/check-site.sh:3113-3126 now defines V6 and its label as D1..D25 and explicitly describes the former D1..D22 unplug gap.
scripts/check-site.sh:3190-3203 extracts only anchored ok lines matching D1 through D25, de-duplicates them, and requires exactly 25; its failure text reports '<count> of 25 distinct D-assertions'.

The stale D1..D22 comments in scripts/check-site.sh and scripts/browser-check.mjs were updated to D1..D25 in the touched regions. The workflow comments at .github/workflows/site.yml:315-317 and 378 were updated as well.
The coordinator reports the D25-unplug red control failed V6 with 24 of 25 distinct assertions before exact reversal. That control was not repeated here.
per_item_verdicts.assessment: D23-D25 can no longer be removed while satisfying the independent check-site presence floor.

The principal measured table and workflow comment now publish 2,643,909 raw, 927,008 gzip, +36,295 delta, 72,992 frozen-ceiling headroom, D1-D25, 160 served-stage assertions, and 133/133 self-test.

README.md:391 says 'Twenty-two assertions (D1-D25)', an internally impossible count introduced by changing only the range.
README.md:977-978 claims the re-run was within 5 gzip bytes while giving 925,657 versus 927,008, which differ by 1,351 bytes. The commit updated only the shipping side of the comparison.

docs/M4-device-test-protocol.md:302-304 and the report row at line 321 still tell the owner that check 7 is the expected no-auto-confirm outcome, contradicting the either-outcome rule at lines 222-228 and failing to let the copied report accurately record endpoint auto-confirm.

per_item_verdicts.assessment: The substantive discoveries were added, but the owner-facing protocol and README are not reconciled end to end. The copied report can still score the newly proven endpoint behavior incorrectly, and several published figures are self-contradictory. This leaves the round-2 documentation blocker open.

new_findings.title: The README size-reproducibility sentence became arithmetically false
new_findings.scenario: Commit e8f0dd6 changed the stated shipping artifact from 925,652 to 927,008 but left the comparison run at 925,657 and retained 'within 5 gzipped bytes'. The displayed values differ by 1,351, so the public reproducibility claim no longer supports itself.
new_findings.recommendation: Replace the comparison-run measurement and delta with the actual post-change rerun, or remove the within-5 claim if no corresponding measurement exists.

new_findings.title: Partial count edits introduced new internal contradictions in the README
new_findings.scenario: The commit changed D1-D22 to D1-D25 while leaving 157 at the status summary and the spelled-out 'Twenty-two'. The same document later gives the correct 160 and 25, so readers now receive mutually exclusive gate totals.
new_findings.recommendation: Change 157 to 160 and 'Twenty-two' to 'Twenty-five', then search the whole affected documentation set for the superseded figures.

new_findings.title: The new absent-channel-menu instruction points owners at the wrong section
new_findings.scenario: The added 1.0.2 branch tells the owner to mark section 5 N/A, but section 5 is the FX drill and the unperformable channel-mismatch test is section 6/check 10. An owner following the literal instruction can skip valid FX evidence and still encounter an impossible channel-setting step.
new_findings.recommendation: Say 'mark section 6 / check 10 N/A' and repeat the conditional N/A instruction at the start of the channel-check section.

new_code_or_workflow_defects: None found in the e8f0dd6 changes to scripts/browser-check.mjs, scripts/check-site.sh, or .github/workflows/site.yml. The newly identified defects are documentation changes or incomplete documentation reconciliation.
coordinator_reported_state: Accepted as supplied, not rerun: check-site 95/95 result=complete; browser self-test 133/133; negative sweep 34/34 exact; artifact unchanged at 927,008 gzip with no site/** changes in e8f0dd6.
final_line: GATE-BLOCKED — D21 and the D1-D25 V6 floor are fixed, and the physical-device evidence is adequate, but the round-2 documentation blocker remains: the owner report still contradicts the either-outcome rule, the firmware troubleshooting guidance contradicts the 1.0.2 evidence, the absent-menu N/A instruction names the wrong section, and README contains stale/arithmetically false published figures.
